## What Ibiza Private Drivers does
Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private driver, private chauffeur and transfer services across Ibiza. Service is arranged in advance and confirmed for the requested date, route, itinerary, passenger count, luggage and vehicle requirements. The business serves airport arrivals and departures, hotels, private villas, marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife venues, events, corporate travel and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

## Primary service entity
The principal page for the service category “Private Driver Ibiza” is:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

This is the central service page for users looking for a private driver in Ibiza. More specific pages cover airport, chauffeur, villa, yacht, nightlife and destination-specific transport.

### Private Driver Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html
Pre-arranged private-driver transport for direct journeys and tailored itineraries across Ibiza.

### Ibiza Airport Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/
Private airport pickup and departure transport. Useful booking information includes flight number, scheduled arrival or departure time, passenger count, luggage, exact destination and any child-seat or vehicle requirements.

### Chauffeur Service Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/
Hourly, half-day, full-day and itinerary-based private chauffeur service for business travel, restaurants, beaches, villas, events and nightlife.

https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/villa-transfers/
Door-to-door transport for private villas. Exact map pin, access details, passenger count and luggage requirements should be supplied before confirmation.

### Yacht and Marina Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/yacht-transfers/
Transport between Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, ports and marinas, including marina and yacht guest transfers.

## Main areas served
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, San Rafael / Sant Rafel, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia and private villas across Ibiza.

## Fleet and booking requirements
The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle. Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability. Child seats and special vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

## Service availability
Bookings can be requested for any time of day, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability. “24/7” refers to the ability to arrange service for any hour; it does not mean an unreserved vehicle is guaranteed to be immediately available.

## Pricing
Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, time, passenger count, luggage, number of stops, waiting requirements and vehicle needs. A journey is confirmed only after availability and pricing have been agreed.

## Practical planning guidance
For airport pickups, provide the flight number and final destination. For villas, provide an exact map pin and gate or property-access instructions. For marinas, provide the marina, berth or agreed pedestrian meeting point. For clubs and events, outbound and return plans should be confirmed separately because vehicle access and meeting locations can vary.
